en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. Dialect and rare words: 'ока' is an old unit of weight (about 1.2 kg), 'драм' a small old unit; 'По тро да си клаваш' is my reading (roughly 'you need not put on make-up'), 'тнонка' is my reading of 'тенка' (slim).

lines.cyr: - В апсана ме кладе дванајсе години,
lines.lat: - V apsana me klade dvanajse godini,
lines.en: - They put me in prison for twelve years,

lines.cyr: - Море лудо младо, гајле да не бериш,
lines.lat: - More ludo mlado, gajle da ne beriš,
lines.en: - Hey, foolish youth, don't take on any worry,

lines.cyr: гајле да не бериш, јаска ќе те чекам,
lines.lat: gajle da ne beriš, jaska ḱe te čekam,
lines.en: don't take on any worry, I will wait for you,

lines.cyr: - Јаска ќе те чекам дванајсе години,
lines.lat: - Jaska ḱe te čekam dvanajse godini,
lines.en: - I will wait for you twelve years,

lines.cyr: - Мори моме мала, аку да си верна,
lines.lat: - Mori mome mala, aku da si verna,
lines.en: - Hey, young girl, if you are faithful,

lines.cyr: аку да си верна бакшиш ќе ти купам,
lines.lat: aku da si verna bakšiš ḱe ti kupam,
lines.en: if you are faithful I will buy you a gift,
I will buy you a gift.

lines.cyr: - Бакшиш ќе ти купам сто драмој белило,
lines.lat: - Bakšiš ḱe ti kupam sto dramoj belilo,
lines.en: - I will buy you a gift, a hundred drams of white face powder,
a hundred drams of white face powder, an ocka of red rouge,

lines.cyr: По тро да си клаваш, сама си убава,
lines.lat: Po tro da si klavaš, sama si ubava,
lines.en: You need no paint, you are beautiful by yourself,
white and red, a little dark-eyed,
